description: The Badass tiers: when they appear (by the PLAYER's level), how strong they are and how their guaranteed drop is shifted. Health, damage, shield, the drop floor and the names are Borderlands 2's (read from the badass survey with tools/badass_report.py, the rule: BL2 file values replace static values); the chances (a Badass roll, then rerolls for Super and Ultimate), speed and size are Skylands choices until the spawn survey (Check-BL2-Spawns.bat) reads BL2's population definitions. See docs/badass-roadmap.md.

columns.player_level_gate: the player's level from which this tier can appear
columns.roll: how the tier is rolled: 'chance' = the chance below, by the player's level; 'reroll' = only after the tier below hit, the SAME chance is rolled again (the user's rule: each tier is recursively rarer). A boss rolls every step at boss_odds times the chance
columns.percent: chance (percent) at the gate level (a reroll uses the Badass row's numbers)
columns.per_level: percent more for every player level above the gate
columns.max_percent: the chance never goes above this
columns.max_near: at most this many of the tier alive within the pump's reach (6000 units); the badass row's number counts every tier
columns.health_mult: max health times this (a tracked temporary Health bonus)
columns.melee_damage_mult: damage of melee, bites, claws and creature attacks times this (BL2: the class's Attribute_EnemyNonWeaponDamageMultiplier against the regular class's, times the champion factor; Skyrim: AttributeDamageMult as a tracked modifier)
columns.gun_damage_mult: damage of a person's gun bullets times this (BL2: weapon damage comes from the gun; a champion only gets Enemy_Damage_PerPlayerPerPlaythroughByChampion 0.74 / 0.65 in single player; the plugin launches with LaunchData.power)
columns.rarity_shift: the drop's rarity weights move up this many rarities
columns.min_rarity: the guaranteed drop is at least this rarity (1 common ... 6 e-tech)
columns.shield_mult: LATER (better gear): the tier's shield capacity times this (BL2: Attribute_EnemyShieldMaxValueMultiplier against the regular class's); not used yet
columns.drops: guaranteed items (gun, shield or relic) when it dies: BL2's 1 / 2 / 3 (the user chose BL2's system)
columns.drop_floors: the lowest rarity of each guaranteed item (1 common ... 4 epic): BL2's lists give uncommon / rare + uncommon / very rare + rare + uncommon
columns.boss_odds: a boss (named, level 35+ or a dragon) rolls each step at this many times the chance; no tier is guaranteed (the user's choice)
columns.source: bl2+design: the columns named in bl2_columns come from Borderlands 2 (tools/badass_report.py on the badass survey), the rest are Skylands choices
columns.bl2_columns: the columns read or derived from Borderlands 2
columns.bl2_object: the Borderlands 2 object the numbers come from ('-' when none yet)

rows.bl2_columns: name_prefix health_mult melee_damage_mult gun_damage_mult shield_mult drops drop_floors min_rarity
rows.note: from player level 1, 3 percent then +0.5 a level (max 25). BL2: health x3.0 = median over 11 regular/Badass class pairs (2.65 without the Varkid, whose regular is a larva); melee x2.28 = median non-weapon damage 2.0 x champion 1.14; one guaranteed uncommon (BadassEnemyGunsAndGear)

rows.bl2_columns: name_prefix health_mult melee_damage_mult gun_damage_mult shield_mult drops drop_floors min_rarity
rows.note: rolled only after a Badass hit, with the same chance again, from player level 12. BL2: a Super is x1.94 the health and x1.15 the damage of its family's Badass (Loader and Varkid, the only two families with a Super class; elsewhere 'Super Badass' is just the Badass's name in the second playthrough); shield x2.0 from the Loader alone; BL2 guarantees a rare + an uncommon

rows.bl2_columns: name_prefix health_mult melee_damage_mult gun_damage_mult shield_mult drops drop_floors min_rarity
rows.note: rolled only after a Super hit, with the same chance again, from player level 25; damage held at the Super's (the user's choice). BL2: health x5 the Badass (the Varkid, the only Ultimate class); its damage x0.75 the Badass would make it hit softer than a Super, so damage and shield are held at the Super's (confirmed by the user); BL2 guarantees a very rare + a rare + an uncommon
